changelog: 🌡️ Phase 19 Upgrade: Native Hardware Telemetry, CPU Topology & Thermal Governor in Rust.
⚡ Real-Time CPU & RAM Telemetry: Direct zero-allocation parsing of CPU frequencies per core, online topology, and Linux /proc/meminfo memory stats.
🛡️ Adaptive Thermal Throttling Governor: Dynamic calculation of throttle multipliers (1.0 to 0.1), token pacing delays, and thread pool scaling to protect mobile devices from thermal runaway.
🔬 Thermal Multi-Zone Diagnostics: Multi-sensor evaluation across CPU thermal zones and battery temperature.
